name: Survey Results Infographics
tagline: Survey-specific infographic deck with blue and red result cards, editable charts, respondent segments, rankings, Likert matrices, and quote clusters.

palette.description: White infographic surface with black type, survey blue, pale blue, red, dark red, and light panel fills.

typography.style: Bold condensed infographic headings with neutral readable body copy.

best_for: User research reports, employee engagement surveys, market polling, customer feedback, and academic survey summaries.
avoid_for: Narrative brand keynotes, luxury product launches, or image-led portfolios that need atmosphere over dense findings.

source_inspiration.name: Slidesgo Survey Results Infographics
source_inspiration.notes: Independent high-fidelity HTML/CSS reconstruction based on public preview thumbnails: white surface, blue/red infographic cards, circular icons, bars, donuts, and survey result modules. No source assets are embedded.
